credential_design.child_to_child_socket: Each connecting child must itself open the real stream and use the original constructor/peer validation. Parent-created stream FDs cannot be relabeled as a different child peer.
credential_design.control: Inherited Root-created socketpair carries bounded fixture metadata only. Its SO_PEERCRED is verified as Root creator, never misused as child identity or role authority.
credential_design.parent_socket: connect_original() opens a real socket and requires SO_PEERCRED UID/GID/PID exactly equal to that designated live child. Original role handshake remains separate.
credential_design.parent_spawn: Root launches the same ELF by read-only inherited descriptor, exact ignored FQN, setpriv --reuid/--regid for one of the fixed UIDs, no groups/capabilities and no_new_privs.
credential_design.startup_ready: Parent validates actual child /proc credentials, boot/start identity and live pidfd. READY proves credential/startup completion only.
credential_design.typed_authority: No typed Client/FD/Arc authority, fabricated handshake/signature/receipt or role success travels through the control metadata channel.

finish_semantics: Signal delivery is not completion. Each finish still requires an actually observed normal exit0 and complete stdout/stderr without overflow/errors. Missing terminal stays unknown; failure cleanup may kill/reap only its own child.

planned_cross_uid_original_channels.evidence: actual Material input to original Trainer; original T control/readback returns on the owned channel
original Trainer readonly evidence used by B/E; original E/Trainer relation uses the same fixed peers
original Trainer command + sealed readonly transition after actual publication
original E command + sealed readonly transition after actual publication
original Root capability/role adapter and actual per-role receipts required

same_host_edges_not_closed.state: Existing public socket constructors reject same UID/PID; sealed same-host readonly API is a separate pending production review.
Original S evidence requires a reviewed same-owner readonly interface; no supplied receipt or test adapter may count as public-path success.

shared_scope.failure_cleanup_anchor: First actual kill/reap cleanup or Drop; all peers use this same absolute deadline.
shared_scope.join_anchor: First finish or early cleanup; all finish calls use this same absolute deadline.
shared_scope.lifetime: All children in one parent fixture use the same scope; it remains within the Root parent process.
shared_scope.notes: The original single-child join5 + exceptional-cleanup5 allowances are shared once by the full group; they are not multiplied by three. No new test/protocol queue or limit.
shared_scope.startup_anchor: Scope creation; all readiness waits and post-credential checks use this same absolute deadline.
